details.imageSource: Chisholm, 1 January 1950, WHO Headquarters Geneva, Switzerland, WHO U27MS4
details.summary: Canadian Deputy Minister of Health and first Director-General of the World Health Organization, 1948-1953
details.life: Was born 18 May 1896 in Oakville, Ontario, and passed away 4 February 1971 in Victoria, British Columbia, Canada. He was the son of Frank Hubert Chisholm, Canadian militia officer, and Lizzie Annett McCraney. On 21 June 1924 he married Grace MacLean Ryrie. They had one daughter and one son.
